# Elements: Data display, media and code

> Plainkit 0.1.0-alpha.1. Generated by scripts/build-skills.mjs from core/dist/elements/api.json. Do not edit: change the source and run the generator.

Every element also takes the usual HTML global attributes (`id`, `class`, `slot`, `hidden`, `aria-*`, `data-*`). Never use a `style` attribute (the CSP blocks it): use props, parts and CSS custom properties.

## `pk-avatar`

**Avatar** (Data display). A person or entity as an image or initials, with sizes, shapes, a stable colour per name and an online, away or busy status dot.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `name` | string | `""` |  | The accessible name and the source of the initials. |
| `src` | `src` | string | `""` |  | An image URL; initials show until it loads or if it fails. |
| `size` | `size` | enum | `"md"` | `md` `sm` `lg` | Size. |
| `shape` | `shape` | enum | `"circle"` | `circle` `square` | Shape. |
| `status` | `status` | enum | `"none"` | `none` `online` `away` `busy` | Status dot. |
| `colour` | `colour` | string | `""` |  | A colour slot 1 to 5, or muted; by default a stable slot chosen from the name. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `initials(name, max)` | Initials for a name. |
| `colourSlot(name, count)` | Stable colour slot. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `image` | The image. |
| `initials` | The initials. |
| `status` | The status dot. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-avatar-size` | `2.25rem` | Diameter. |
| `--pk-avatar-bg` | `the colour slot` | Fill colour. |
| `--pk-avatar-fg` | `var(--chart-on)` | Initials colour. |

**Accessibility.** role=img with the name (and status) as its label; the image itself has an empty alt because the host already names it.

Example: Sizes and status

```html
<pk-avatar name="Ada Lovelace" size="sm"></pk-avatar>
<pk-avatar name="Sam Lee" status="online"></pk-avatar>
<pk-avatar name="Ana Ruiz" size="lg" shape="square"></pk-avatar>
```

## `pk-avatar-group`

**AvatarGroup** (Data display). Overlapping avatars with a +N tile for the overflow.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `max` | `max` | number | `4` |  | Avatars shown before the +N tile. |
| `label` | `label` | string | `""` |  | Accessible name of the group. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | pk-avatar children. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `groupOverflow(people, max)` | Shown people and the remainder. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `more` | The +N tile. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-avatar-group-overlap` | `var(--space-2)` | How far avatars overlap. |

**Accessibility.** role=group with a label; the +N tile is text, so the count of hidden people is available without seeing them.

Example: Overflow

```html
<pk-avatar-group max="2" label="Team">
  <pk-avatar name="Ada L"></pk-avatar>
  <pk-avatar name="Sam L"></pk-avatar>
  <pk-avatar name="Ana R"></pk-avatar>
</pk-avatar-group>
```

## `pk-badge`

**Badge** (Data display). A count or short label in a pill, or a status dot with a label; counts cap at a maximum (99+).

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `variant` | enum | `"accent"` | `accent` `muted` `ok` `warn` `danger` `outline` | Colour. |
| `count` | `count` | string | `""` |  | Value to show when the slot is empty, capped by max. |
| `max` | `max` | number | `99` |  | Counts above read as max+; 0 disables capping. |
| `dot` | `dot` | boolean | `false` |  | A status dot with the text as its label instead of a pill. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Text; overrides the count. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `formatCount(value, max)` | Text such as 99+. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `dot` | The status dot. |
| `text` | The label wrapper. |
| `count` | The formatted count shown when the slot is empty. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-badge-bg` | `the variant colour` | Pill fill. |
| `--pk-badge-fg` | `the variant text colour` | Pill text. |

**Accessibility.** The text is the accessible name; put a noun in the slot ("4 unread") when the count alone is ambiguous. Dot mode never relies on colour alone: the label states the status.

Example: Variants

```html
<pk-badge count="12"></pk-badge>
<pk-badge variant="ok">Live</pk-badge>
<pk-badge variant="danger" count="120"></pk-badge>
```

Example: Status dots

```html
<pk-badge dot variant="ok">Online</pk-badge>
<pk-badge dot variant="warn">Syncing</pk-badge>
```

## `pk-chart`

**Chart** (Data display). Bar, line, donut, stacked-bar and sparkline charts in pure SVG, drawn from a slotted data table (which stays as the accessible fallback) or from a data property.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `kind` | enum | `"bar"` | `bar` `line` `donut` `stack` `spark` | Chart type. |
| `caption` | `caption` | string | `""` |  | Title (figcaption). |
| `height` | `height` | number | `140` |  | viewBox height of bar and line charts. |
| `data` | `data` | json (a JSON attribute, or set the property) | `null` |  | Data as a property instead of a table: { labels: string[], series: { name, values: number[] }[] }. |
| `data-label` | `dataLabel` | string | `"Show data"` |  | Summary text of the data details. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | A table: the first column holds labels, each further column a series. A cell may carry data-value. |
| `caption` | A rich caption; overrides caption. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `barRects(series)` | Bar geometry. |
| `linePoints(series)` | Line points. |
| `donutSegments(values)` | Donut dash arrays. |
| `sparkPoints(values)` | Sparkline points. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `figure` | The figure. |
| `caption` | The caption. |
| `plot` | The svg container. |
| `legend` | The legend list. |
| `data` | The data details. |
| `data-toggle` | The data details summary. |

**Accessibility.** The svg is role=img with a generated text alternative listing the values; the source table stays in a details for exact numbers. Series colours are the chart tokens and every multi-series chart has a legend, so colour is not the only key.

Example: Bar from a table

```html
<pk-chart kind="bar" caption="Sales">
  <table><thead><tr><th>Month</th><th>Sales</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody><tr><th scope="row">Jan</th><td>4</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">Feb</th><td>6</td></tr></tbody></table>
</pk-chart>
```

Example: Donut and stack

```html
<pk-chart kind="donut" caption="Channels">
  <table><thead><tr><th>Channel</th><th>Orders</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody><tr><th scope="row">Web</th><td>52</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">Market</th><td>31</td></tr></tbody></table>
</pk-chart>
```

## `pk-code-block`

**Code block** (Code). A block of code with an optional label bar, line numbers, a wrap toggle and a copy button. The code is the element's text content.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `label` | string | `""` |  | File or language shown in the bar; also the region's name. |
| `line-numbers` | `lineNumbers` | boolean | `false` |  | A gutter of line numbers. |
| `wrap` | `wrap` | boolean | `false` |  | Wrap long lines. |
| `no-copy` | `noCopy` | boolean | `false` |  | Hide the copy button. |
| `max-height` | `maxHeight` | string | `""` |  | Cap the height, any CSS length. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-copy` | `{ ok: bool }` | After a copy attempt. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `splitLines(text)` | Lines without blank ends. |
| `dedent(text)` | Remove the shared indent. |
| `copyText(text)` | Async clipboard copy. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `bar` | The header bar. |
| `label` | The label. |
| `wrap` | The wrap toggle. |
| `copy` | The copy button. |
| `status` | The live region for the copy result. |
| `body` | The scrolling region. |
| `code` | The pre. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-code-block-bg` | `var(--cv-bg)` | Background. |
| `--pk-code-block-fg` | `var(--cv-text)` | Text colour. |
| `--pk-code-block-max-height` | `none` | Maximum body height. |
| `--pk-code-block-gutter` | `2` | Line-number width in characters; set by the element. |

**Accessibility.** The body is a labelled, focusable region so a keyboard can scroll it; the copy result is announced in a polite status region; line numbers are CSS-generated and not selectable. Lines are set as text, never parsed as HTML.

Example: With line numbers

```html
<pk-code-block label="import.json" line-numbers>{ "sku": "AC-001", "qty": 24 }</pk-code-block>
```

## `pk-field-list`

**Field list** (Data display). A titled description list: term and value pairs as slotted dt and dd, beside each other, stacked or run in; with dividers and a dense mode.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `heading` | `heading` | string | `""` |  | Section title. |
| `level` | `level` | number | `3` |  | Heading level exposed to assistive technology. |
| `layout` | `layout` | enum | `"grid"` | `grid` `stacked` | Term beside value, or above it. |
| `dividers` | `dividers` | boolean | `false` |  | A rule under each value. |
| `dense` | `dense` | boolean | `false` |  | Tighter rhythm and smaller text. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | dt and dd pairs; a dd may hold chips, links or code. |
| `heading` | A rich heading; overrides heading. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `section` | The wrapper. |
| `heading` | The heading. |
| `list` | The description list. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-field-list-term` | `minmax(9rem, 1fr)` | The term column width. |
| `--pk-field-list-columns` | `term column and 2fr; one column on a phone` | The whole column template, for a page that re-flows the list (a flyout on a phone sizes the term to its text; a wide card runs two pairs per line). |
| `--pk-field-list-gap` | `0` | Row and column gap on a phone. |

**Accessibility.** A real description list: slotted dt and dd are exposed as terms and definitions. The heading names the section. Below 640px the pairs stack.

Example: Product fields

```html
<pk-field-list heading="Identifiers">
  <dt>SKU</dt><dd><code>AC-001</code></dd>
  <dt>Vendor</dt><dd>Acme Supply</dd>
</pk-field-list>
```

Example: Stacked, dense

```html
<pk-field-list layout="stacked" dense>
  <dt>Cost</dt><dd>$2.10</dd>
</pk-field-list>
```

## `pk-gallery`

**Gallery** (Data display). The SDK gallery inside your page: every control, element, layout and template with live samples, narrowed by attributes to just what you want to show. Loads on demand in its own frame.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `kind` | string | `""` |  | What to show: foundations, controls, elements, layouts or templates. Empty shows the controls when a group or control is named, otherwise everything. |
| `group` | `group` | string | `""` |  | One control group by name ("Forms & inputs") or slug (forms-inputs); with kind layouts or templates, that samples group. |
| `control` | `control` | string | `""` |  | One control, element or sample id, or a comma separated list ("button,input"); elements also match by tag (pk-tabs). |
| `theme` | `theme` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto` `dark` `light` | The theme of the gallery and its samples. auto keeps the gallery's own default (dark). |
| `width` | `width` | enum | `"desktop"` | `desktop` `phone` | Render the samples at desktop width or in a 375px phone frame. |
| `filter` | `filter` | string | `""` |  | Search text: only controls whose name (or group) contains it are shown. |
| `chrome` | `chrome` | enum | `"none"` | `none` `full` | none shows only the content, sized to fit it; full keeps the contents nav, the viewport and text size toolbar and the element inspector (Details: an element's API and live markup). |
| `height` | `height` | number | `0` |  | A fixed height in pixels. 0 fits the content when chrome is none and uses the default height when chrome is full. |
| `src` | `src` | string | `""` |  | Address of the gallery's embed.html when it is not next to the element module, for example on a CDN prefix. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `frame` | The iframe that hosts the gallery. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-gallery-height` | `28rem` | Height of the frame. The element sets it from height or from the height the gallery reports. |

**Accessibility.** The frame is titled "SDK gallery". With chrome full, the gallery is a landmark layout with a contents nav, a toolbar and a labelled inspector; with chrome none it is the content alone, and each sample sits in its own titled frame.

Example: Every form control, phone width, light theme

```html
<pk-gallery kind="controls" group="Forms & inputs" width="phone" theme="light"></pk-gallery>
```

Example: Two controls only

```html
<pk-gallery control="button,badge"></pk-gallery>
```

Example: The full gallery at a fixed height

```html
<pk-gallery chrome="full" height="560"></pk-gallery>
```

## `pk-icon`

**Icon** (Media). A symbol from the SDK sprite, drawn in the surrounding text colour and size. The sprite is found next to the element module, so it works wherever dist is copied.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `name` | string | `""` |  | The symbol id in the sprite (search, settings, orders, ...). |
| `size` | `size` | enum | `"md"` | `sm` `md` `lg` `xl` | md is 1.25em and follows the text; sm, lg and xl are fixed steps of the space scale. |
| `label` | `label` | string | `""` |  | The accessible name. Without it the icon is decorative and hidden from assistive technology. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `svg` | The svg element. |
| `use` | The use element that points into the sprite. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-icon-size` | `the size step` | Width and height, overriding size. |

**Accessibility.** With a label the host is role img with that name; without one it is aria-hidden, so put the meaning in the surrounding text (a button label) and leave the icon decorative. The stroke follows currentColor, so it meets the contrast of its text. Give an icon-only button a 44px target.

Example: Follows text colour and size

```html
<p><pk-icon name="search"></pk-icon> Search &nbsp; <pk-icon name="settings" label="Settings"></pk-icon> &nbsp; <pk-icon name="orders" size="xl"></pk-icon></p>
```

Example: Size steps

```html
<pk-icon name="search" size="sm"></pk-icon> <pk-icon name="search"></pk-icon> <pk-icon name="search" size="lg"></pk-icon> <pk-icon name="search" size="xl"></pk-icon>
```

## `pk-image-gallery`

**Image gallery** (Data display). A grid of square thumbnails with one marked primary (a badge and an accent frame). Clicking a thumbnail opens the lightbox. Editable, it adds a make-primary and a remove button under each image and an add tile that picks files.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `images` | `images` | json (a JSON attribute, or set the property) | `[]` |  | The images: [{ src, alt, primary?, status? }]. status is a short warning badge such as Staged. Property or a JSON attribute. Only same-site paths, http(s) and raster data URLs are shown. |
| `primary` | `primary` | number | `-1` |  | The index of the primary image; -1 uses the first image flagged primary in images, or none. |
| `columns` | `columns` | number | `0` |  | A fixed number of equal columns (1 to 12). 0 fits as many as min allows. |
| `min` | `min` | string | `"6.25rem"` |  | The narrowest a thumbnail may get, as a css length in px, rem or em. Used when columns is 0. |
| `editable` | `editable` | boolean | `false` |  | Show make-primary and remove buttons under each image and the add tile. |
| `add-label` | `addLabel` | string | `"Add image"` |  | Text on the add tile. |
| `accept` | `accept` | string | `"image/*"` |  | The file types the add tile's picker offers. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-primary-change` | `{ index: number, src: string, previous: number }` | Make primary was pressed. Cancelable: preventDefault keeps the current primary (a controlled gallery updates images and primary itself). |
| `pk-remove` | `{ index: number, src: string }` | Remove was pressed. Cancelable: preventDefault keeps the image. Otherwise it is taken out of images, and if it was the primary the first image becomes the primary. |
| `pk-add` | `{ files: File[], names: string[] }` | Files were chosen on the add tile. The gallery adds nothing itself: read the files (a data URL) and set images. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `view(index)` | Opens the lightbox at an image. |
| `makePrimary(index)` | Marks an image primary, as the button does (raises pk-primary-change first). |
| `removeImage(index)` | Removes an image, as the button does (raises pk-remove first). |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `grid` | The thumbnail list. |
| `tile` | One thumbnail with its badges and buttons. |
| `media` | The thumbnail's pk-media. |
| `badge` | The Primary badge. |
| `status` | The status badge (Staged and the like). |
| `actions` | The row of buttons under an image. |
| `action` | A make-primary or remove pk-button. |
| `add-tile` | The list item holding the add tile. |
| `add` | The add tile (a label around the file input). |
| `add-icon` | The plus on the add tile. |
| `add-text` | The text on the add tile. |
| `file` | The file input. |
| `viewer` | The pk-lightbox. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-image-gallery-radius` | `var(--radius-lg)` | Corner radius of the thumbnails and the add tile. |

**Accessibility.** The grid is a list. Each thumbnail is a button that opens the lightbox (Enter or Space); its name is the image's alt text. Make primary and Remove name their image ("Remove: Back view"). The add tile is a real file input, reachable and operable by keyboard, with a visible focus ring. After a removal focus moves to the next image, or the add tile when none is left. Primary and status are text badges, never colour alone.

Example: Thumbnails with a primary image and an add tile


## `pk-list-group`

**List group** (Data display). A bordered list of rows: plain, actionable (links and buttons), with badges at the end, or a checklist.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `variant` | enum | `"plain"` | `plain` `action` `flush` | Row behaviour and frame. |
| `checklist` | `checklist` | boolean | `false` |  | Rows are labels with a checkbox. |
| `label` | `label` | string | `""` |  | Accessible name of the list. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Rows: div, a, button or label elements. |

**Accessibility.** The host is role=list and each row gets role=listitem unless it already has a role. Rows are native links, buttons or labels, so keyboard and names come from them. The current row uses aria-current. Actionable rows are at least 44px tall.

Example: Actionable with badges

```html
<pk-list-group variant="action" label="Shortcuts">
  <a href="#">Receive PO 1042 <pk-badge count="3" variant="warn"></pk-badge></a>
  <a href="#" aria-current="page">Low stock</a>
</pk-list-group>
```

Example: Checklist

```html
<pk-list-group checklist label="Receiving">
  <label><input type="checkbox"> Count boxes</label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" checked> Check slip</label>
</pk-list-group>
```

## `pk-local-time`

**Local time** (Data display). A UTC instant written in the reader's own locale and time zone, as a date, a time, both, or relative to now (3 hours ago). Keeps a real time element inside, so the machine value stays readable.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `datetime` | `datetime` | string | `""` |  | The instant: an ISO 8601 string (2026-09-19T14:30:00Z). A date-only value is a calendar day and is never shifted by the time zone. |
| `format` | `format` | enum | `"datetime"` | `datetime` `date` `time` `relative` | What to show. relative reads 3 hours ago and refreshes every 30 seconds while connected; its title holds the full date. |
| `length` | `length` | enum | `"medium"` | `short` `medium` `long` | How much of the date to spell out (9/19/26, Sep 19, 2026, September 19, 2026). |
| `locale` | `locale` | string | `""` |  | A BCP 47 tag such as de-DE; empty uses the reader's browser locale. |
| `time-zone` | `timeZone` | string | `""` |  | An IANA zone such as Europe/Berlin; empty uses the reader's own zone. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Fallback text, shown only while the datetime is empty or not a date. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `formatLocal(value, options)` | The pure formatter the element uses: format, length, locale, timeZone and now. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `time` | The inner time element (its datetime attribute is the machine value). |
| `text` | The formatted text. |

**Accessibility.** The text is inside a real time element carrying the datetime, so assistive technology and search see the exact instant. Relative text is not live-announced; the title holds the full date for pointer users. Prefer date or datetime where the exact moment matters.

Example: Date, time and both

```html
<p><pk-local-time datetime="2026-09-19T14:30:00Z"></pk-local-time></p>
<p><pk-local-time datetime="2026-09-19T14:30:00Z" format="date" length="long"></pk-local-time> at <pk-local-time datetime="2026-09-19T14:30:00Z" format="time"></pk-local-time></p>
```

Example: Relative and another locale

```html
<p>Updated <pk-local-time datetime="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z" format="relative"></pk-local-time></p>
<p><pk-local-time datetime="2026-09-19T14:30:00Z" locale="de-DE" time-zone="Europe/Berlin"></pk-local-time></p>
```

## `pk-media`

**Media** (Media). An image or video in a fixed aspect-ratio box with an optional figure caption and lightbox-ready behaviour.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ratio` | `ratio` | string | `"16/9"` |  | Aspect ratio as width/height: 16/9, 4/3, 1/1, 3/4. |
| `fit` | `fit` | enum | `"cover"` | `cover` `contain` | How media fills the box. |
| `caption` | `caption` | string | `""` |  | Figure caption. |
| `lightbox` | `lightbox` | boolean | `false` |  | The box becomes a button that fires pk-open. |
| `square` | `square` | boolean | `false` |  | Square corners. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | An img, picture, video or svg. |
| `caption` | A rich caption; overrides caption. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-open` | `{ src: string, alt: string, caption: string }` | A lightbox request. Cancel if you handle it yourself. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `figure` | The figure. |
| `box` | The ratio box. |
| `caption` | The caption. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-media-radius` | `var(--radius-md)` | Corner radius. |

**Accessibility.** A real figure with a figcaption; slotted images keep their author-written alt text. Lightbox mode makes the box a focusable button (Enter and Space) named "Enlarge". The ratio reserves space so a late image never shifts the layout.

Example: Captioned 4:3

```html
<pk-media ratio="4/3" caption="Widget 1">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 4 3" role="img" aria-label="Placeholder"><rect width="4" height="3" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.15"></rect></svg>
</pk-media>
```

## `pk-stat`

**Stat tile** (Data display). A headline number with a label, an optional change indicator (arrow, sign and a spoken form), a sparkline and a tone. With an href the whole tile is one link. The tile prop gives the compact dashboard look; interactive makes a tile with no href a button.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `label` | string | `""` |  | What the number is. |
| `value` | `value` | string | `""` |  | The headline number, already formatted. |
| `subtext` | `subtext` | string | `""` |  | A line under the value. |
| `tone` | `tone` | enum | `"neutral"` | `neutral` `positive` `warning` `critical` | Value colour. |
| `delta` | `delta` | string | `""` |  | The change, for example 12.5 or -3; shows an arrow and a signed number, a percentage unless deltaUnit says points. |
| `delta-unit` | `deltaUnit` | enum | `"percent"` | `percent` `points` | What delta measures: percent shows +12.5%, points shows +4 pts (a score or rate that moved by an absolute amount) and is spoken as points. |
| `delta-direction` | `deltaDirection` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto` `up` `down` `flat` | Override the direction derived from delta. |
| `invert` | `invert` | boolean | `false` |  | Down is good news (costs, returns): swaps the trend colours. |
| `versus` | `versus` | string | `"the previous period"` |  | What the change compares with, spoken to assistive technology. |
| `values` | `values` | json (a JSON attribute, or set the property) | `[]` |  | Points for the sparkline (needs at least two). |
| `href` | `href` | string | `""` |  | Makes the tile a link. |
| `tile` | `tile` | boolean | `false` |  | The compact dashboard tile look: less padding, a 600-weight larger value, a panel background. |
| `interactive` | `interactive` | boolean | `false` |  | Without an href, make the tile a button (Enter and Space) that fires pk-activate. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `icon` | An icon before the value. |
| (default) | The subtext; overrides subtext. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-activate` | `{ href: string }` | The tile link was pressed. Cancel to stop navigation (a Blazor OnClick handler navigates itself). |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `delta(current, previous)` | Direction and percent. |
| `formatDelta(d, unit)` | A signed percentage, or points when unit is points. |
| `deltaSpeech(d, versus, unit)` | The spoken form. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `tile` | The panel. |
| `label` | The label. |
| `row` | The value row. |
| `value` | The value. |
| `delta` | The change indicator. |
| `subtext` | The subtext wrapper. |
| `spark` | The sparkline wrapper. |
| `link` | The overlay link. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-stat-value-size` | `1.5rem` | Value font size. |

**Accessibility.** The change is text (an arrow glyph and a sign) and has a spoken form ("up 12.5 percent versus last month"), so colour is never the only signal. A tile with href holds one link named by the label and value, so there is a single tab stop. An interactive tile is a role=button overlay reachable by keyboard.

Example: Tones

```html
<pk-stat label="Open POs" value="12"></pk-stat>
<pk-stat label="Negative on hand" value="3" tone="critical" href="#"></pk-stat>
```

Example: Change and trend

```html
<pk-stat label="Sales, September" value="$18,420" delta="12.5" versus="last month" values='[12,15,14,17,18]'></pk-stat>
<pk-stat label="Return rate" value="2.1%" delta="-0.4" invert></pk-stat>
```

Example: Change in points

```html
<pk-stat label="Quality score" value="87" delta="4" delta-unit="points" versus="last run"></pk-stat>
```

Example: Dashboard tile as a button

```html
<pk-stat tile interactive label="Open orders" value="12"></pk-stat>
```

## `pk-table`

**Table** (Data display). A data table. Two modes: hand it a raw table in the default slot (rows and cells exactly as authored) and it supplies the scroll frame, toolbar, bulk, empty and footer slots; or give it columns and rows and it renders the table itself, with sorting, filtering, selection, loading and phone cards. The data-driven mode: striped, hover, bordered, density, sticky header and first column, sortable headers, filter row, row selection with a bulk bar, loading and empty states and a card layout on a phone. Custom cell content goes in slots named cell-<rowId>-<key>. With manual set, the host owns sorting, filtering and paging and the element only renders and reports.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `columns` | json (a JSON attribute, or set the property) | `[]` |  | Column definitions: { key, label, type?: text\|number\|date, align?: start\|end, sortable?, hidePhone? }[]. A JSON attribute or a property. |
| `rows` | `rows` | json (a JSON attribute, or set the property) | `[]` |  | Row data, one object per row. A JSON attribute or a property. |
| `row-key` | `rowKey` | string | `"id"` |  | The field that identifies a row. |
| `striped` | `striped` | boolean | `false` |  | Alternate row tint. |
| `hover` | `hover` | boolean | `false` |  | Tint the row under the pointer. |
| `bordered` | `bordered` | boolean | `false` |  | Border on every cell. |
| `density` | `density` | enum | `"default"` | `default` `compact` `comfortable` | Cell padding step. |
| `sticky-header` | `stickyHeader` | boolean | `false` |  | Pin the header row (give the table a maxHeight). |
| `sticky-column` | `stickyColumn` | boolean | `false` |  | Pin the first column. |
| `selectable` | `selectable` | boolean | `false` |  | Checkbox column with select-all. |
| `clickable` | `clickable` | boolean | `false` |  | Rows are activatable: they show a pointer and fire pk-row-click. |
| `filterable` | `filterable` | boolean | `false` |  | A filter input under each header. |
| `manual` | `manual` | boolean | `false` |  | The host sorts, filters and pages; rows are shown exactly as given. |
| `sort` | `sort` | string | `""` |  | Key of the column being sorted. |
| `sort-dir` | `sortDir` | enum | `"ascending"` | `ascending` `descending` | Sort direction. |
| `filters` | `filters` | json (a JSON attribute, or set the property) | `{}` |  | Filter text per column key: { [key]: text }. |
| `selected` | `selected` | json (a JSON attribute, or set the property) | `[]` |  | Ids of the selected rows. |
| `loading` | `loading` | boolean | `false` |  | Show placeholder rows and mark the table busy. |
| `cards` | `cards` | boolean | `false` |  | Each row becomes a card below 640px. |
| `caption` | `caption` | string | `""` |  | Table caption. |
| `label` | `label` | string | `""` |  | Accessible name of the scrolling region. |
| `max-height` | `maxHeight` | string | `""` |  | Bounds the frame; sticky header and column need it. |
| `flow` | `flow` | boolean | `false` |  | Slotted-table mode: no scroll frame, for a table inside a container that already scrolls. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | A raw table (thead, tbody, tfoot, any rows). The page-level layer styles it; the element frames it. |
| `toolbar` | Search, filters and buttons above the table. |
| `bulk` | Actions shown while rows are selected. |
| `caption` | Rich caption. |
| `empty` | Empty state; an pk-empty-state fits. |
| `footer` | Below the table; an pk-pagination fits. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-sort` | `{ key: string, direction: string }` | A sortable header was activated. Cancel to keep the current sort. |
| `pk-filter` | `{ filters: IDictionary<string, string> }` | A filter input changed (debounced 250 ms). |
| `pk-select` | `{ selected: IReadOnlyList<string> }` | The selection changed. |
| `pk-row-click` | `{ id: string, row: object }` | A clickable row was activated. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `sortBy(key, direction)` | Sort programmatically. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `toolbar` | The toolbar wrapper. |
| `bulk` | The bulk bar. |
| `bulk-count` | The selected count. |
| `scroll` | The scrolling frame. |
| `table` | The table. |
| `caption` | The caption. |
| `head` | The thead. |
| `body` | The tbody. |
| `empty` | The empty wrapper. |
| `footer` | The footer wrapper. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-table-max-height` | `none` | Height of the scrolling frame (set from maxHeight). |

**Accessibility.** A real table with a caption, aria-rowcount and aria-busy. Sortable headers hold a button and carry aria-sort. The scrolling frame is a labelled focusable region so the keyboard can scroll it. Checkboxes name their row; the selection count is a polite status. The card layout keeps the header for assistive technology. Cell values are set as text, never parsed as HTML.

Example: Sortable, selectable table

```html
<pk-table id="t1" label="Products" caption="Stock by product" striped hover selectable
  columns='[{"key":"sku","label":"SKU","sortable":true},{"key":"price","label":"Price","type":"number","sortable":true}]'
  rows='[{"id":1,"sku":"AC-001","price":"$4.99"},{"id":2,"sku":"AC-002","price":"$3.99"}]'>
  <pk-button slot="bulk" size="mini" variant="ghost">Archive</pk-button>
</pk-table>
```

Example "Empty and loading" is left out: the source uses the attribute `empty-text`, which is not a prop of `pk-table`; put the empty state in the `empty` slot (a `pk-empty-state` fits) and use `loading` for the loading state.

Example "Expandable rows" is left out: the source uses an `expandable` attribute and `detail-<n>` slots, which `pk-table` does not have (it has no expandable rows).

## `pk-tag`

**Tag** (Data display). A neutral label that can carry a remove button.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `removable` | `removable` | boolean | `false` |  | Show the remove button. |
| `value` | `value` | string | `""` |  | Sent in the remove event; defaults to the text. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | boolean | `false` |  | Dim the tag and disable the button. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The label. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-remove` | `{ value: string }` | The remove button was pressed. Cancel to keep the tag; otherwise it removes itself. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `label` | The label. |
| `remove` | The remove button. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-tag-bg` | `var(--color-surface-alt)` | Fill. |
| `--pk-tag-border` | `var(--color-border)` | Border colour. |

**Accessibility.** The remove control is a real button named "Remove <label>"; it is 44px on a phone.

Example: Removable

```html
<pk-tag removable>Green</pk-tag>
<pk-tag removable>Variant</pk-tag>
<pk-tag>Signed</pk-tag>
```

## `pk-timeline`

**Timeline** (Data display). A vertical activity feed of timeline items joined by a line.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `label` | string | `""` |  | Accessible name of the list. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | pk-timeline-item children, in the order to show them. |

**Accessibility.** The host is role=list; each pk-timeline-item is a listitem with a real time element. State is also given in words in the heading when it matters, never by the marker colour alone.

Example: Order history

```html
<pk-timeline label="Order history">
  <pk-timeline-item heading="Shipped" time="2026-09-16" status="done">Tracking 9400.</pk-timeline-item>
  <pk-timeline-item heading="Packed" time="2026-09-15" status="active"></pk-timeline-item>
</pk-timeline>
```

## `pk-timeline-item`

**Timeline item** (Data display). One event on a timeline: a marker, a heading, a time and a body.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `heading` | `heading` | string | `""` |  | Title of the event. |
| `time` | `time` | string | `""` |  | An ISO date or any text; shown in a time element. |
| `status` | `status` | enum | `"pending"` | `pending` `done` `active` `danger` | Marker colour and fill. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The body. |
| `heading` | A rich heading; overrides heading. |
| `time` | A rich time; overrides time. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `marker` | The dot. |
| `content` | Heading, time and body. |
| `head` | The heading row. |
| `heading` | The heading. |
| `time` | The time. |
| `body` | The body. |

**Accessibility.** role=listitem through ElementInternals; the time uses a real time element with a datetime attribute.

Example: Statuses

```html
<pk-timeline-item heading="Delivered" time="2026-09-18" status="done"></pk-timeline-item>
<pk-timeline-item heading="Payment failed" status="danger">Retried and cleared.</pk-timeline-item>
```
